verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents a dedicated 'Fivetran Alerts' feature in the dashboard and a webhooks mechanism for usage/event data, plus an MCP tool that lets you query sync status ('was my last postgres sync successful', 'are any connections broken'), which supports run-status visibility. However, the evidence never specifies Slack or email as alert delivery channels, nor does it detail per-sync row-count logging or log viewing in the dashboard. missing for 10: explicit Slack/email alert channel documentation, per-sync row count reporting, detailed sync log access.
